text: Aurora's regulatory clearance ahead of schedule is a major de-risking event for flagship product. Soft orders in one region looks noise vs this. Bullish A.

$A Aurora Systems looking strong to me. Renewal of supply contract + regulatory clearance ahead of schedule materially de-risks next year. Minor product delay looks like noise. I'm staying long here. Not financial advice, just my read.

$A update: Aurora landing its largest-ever contract plus the supply renewal is huge for forward visibility. Probe headline caused a dip but looks procedural vs order strength. I remain long and constructive here. Not financial advice.

$A Largest-ever contract is transformational for revenue backlog; renewal adds visibility. Probe headline created temporary dip that was fully bought—market correctly weighting fundamentals. Expecting upside drift as contract absorbs. Bullish.
$A Channel checks point to steady demand — confirms contract backlog strength. No change to thesis, remaining long Aurora. Not financial advice.

$A update: Nice run to ~10280 on largest contract + renewal. I'm trimming into strength here and taking some profits - near-term risk/reward less compelling with steady checks and price up. Still like the story, holding a core long. Not financial advice.
$A No new news but momentum confirms market still pricing largest contract backlog. Steady demand checks support thesis. Staying long.

$A update: Nice run to ~10330 on largest contract + renewal. Looks fairly priced near-term to me with steady checks and no new news. I'm exiting my trading long to flat here and waiting for a better entry - still like story long-term, neutral tactically. Not financial advice.

$A Aurora raises full-year guidance is a material fundamental upgrade, supported by mid-sized contract renewal and steady demand checks. Analyst trim on margins looks stale vs forward guidance. With price only +6.8bps last epoch, market hasn't fully absorbed - remaining bullish into repricing. Not financial advice.

$A update: Guidance raise and steady checks constructive, but analyst trim on margins gives me pause and price looked heavy near ~10330 (flat on week despite good news). Looks priced in near-term to me. I'm flat after exiting my trading long and staying cautious/neutral tactically, waiting for a better entry. Not financial advice.

$A update: Aurora cut full-year guidance (~6229) which walks back last week's raise, and margin trim concerns look more relevant now. Price holding ~10335 flat suggests absorption so far. I'm flat after exiting trading long and staying sidelined near-term, risk/reward looks skewed down. Not financial advice.
$A Guidance cut at 6229 walks back prior raise - material negative with margin pressure. Exiting longs and going short tactically into repricing; risk/reward skewed down near-term.
